ev: OzKleen's next breakthrough came when the daughter of a Coles Myer executive used the product while on holiday in Queensland and convinced her father that Shower Power should be sold in Coles supermarkets.

ev: Everybody at the factory had to collaborate, labelling and bottling Shower Power to keep up with requirements.

ev: OzKleen's turnaround began when Quinn and Heron hired an industrial chemist to revitalise the product line.

4.why: Thông tin: lý do thay đổi kích cỡ bao bì. Đoạn D: ban đầu chỉ bán số lượng lớn, sau chuyển sang chai 750ml vì khách lẻ ở cửa hàng rất thích → D.

ev: In 1995, Tom Quinn and John Heron bought a struggling cleaning products business, OzKleen, for A$250,000.
5.why: Thông tin: nguồn gốc của công ty OzKleen. Đoạn B: năm 1995, Quinn và Heron mua lại công ty OzKleen đang gặp khó khăn → B.

ev: The company also wanted to make the product formulas more environmentally friendly.

ev: after it was so well received by customers at their retail store at Beenleigh, near Brisbane. Customers were travelling long distances to buy supplies.

ev: OzKleen stopped manufacturing all other products and rebuilt the business around Shower Power.

ev: OzKleen has also been approached with offers to buy the company, but Tom Quinn says he is happy with things as they are.

ev: Peter Quinn says OzKleen spends as much money as they require on research and development and that can be considerable sums.
